Watermelon Smoothie Recipe
By: lisa lore
Published: Thursday, August 1, 2013 - 5:51am

Ingredients




•A watermelon
•1 cup ice
•1 tablespoon sugar (You can add more or less to taste)

Preparation

1 1.Gather your ingredients, listed above. 2 2.Cut the watermelon with a good, sharp knife down the middle either way. Slice into smaller pieces and measure out 2 cups. Make sure to keep all of the skin out. 3 3.Put ingredients into a blender and blend on “ice chop” setting until blended. 4 4.Pour into tall glasses and serve right away. You can even slice a piece of watermelon and stick it on the top of the glass.

About

There is nothing better on a hot summer day than an ice cold Watermelon Smoothie.
